g.text: Pointer-Screen Cascade & Active Screen Elimination Flow
Please use '!option handwritten true' to enable handwritten
Move cursor to desired monitor (e.g. Display 1)
Calculate invariant cascade frames on Display 1
Apply target frames & restack Z on Display 1 only
Zero focus-click required to switch target display.
- "Cascade All Screens" available for full arrangement
- Target Screen submenu dedicates solely to Auto-Rearrange
